# llms.txt - AI Agent & LLM Crawler Guidelines for Hirix Pakistan

# Hirix Pakistan - Premier Hiring & Career Hub

> Hirix connects top software, engineering, and marketing candidates with leading employers across Pakistan (Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad).

## Primary Navigation & Resources

- [Home Page](https://hirix.com.pk/): Explore active job counts, featured opportunities, and top hiring categories.
- [Career Blog](https://hirix.com.pk/blog): Industry insights, resume tips, and career guides.
- [About Hirix](https://hirix.com.pk/about): Learn about our recruitment ecosystem and company mission.
- [Contact Support](https://hirix.com.pk/contact): Get in touch with our team.
- [Jobs Portal](https://jobs.hirix.com.pk): Live applicant and employer portal for listing and applying to jobs.

## Documentation & API Endpoints

- API Base URL: `https://api.hirix.com.pk`
- Blog Endpoints: `/get-blogs`, `/get-blog/{slug}`
- Job Listings Endpoint: `/get-latest-jobs`, `/get-posts`
